name: guto-skills
description: Phase-scoped engineering orchestration with mandatory context engineering and vendored Agent Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, verify, and review with focused local context.
interface.longDescription: Guto Skills provides four explicitly invoked engineering phases. Each phase starts with context engineering, calls only its exact vendored child-skill set, persists the master plan, and stops for human audit.
defaultPrompt: Use guto-plan to create an approved implementation plan from the real repository context
Use guto-review to reconstruct context and review a verified change for merge readiness
